recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的巨大多核細胞乍看像蝕骨細胞，但細胞質為深藍色、無粉紅顆粒，細胞核具漿細胞樣粗塊狀染色質，旁邊並有雙核與多核的異型漿細胞；FISH 以箭頭標示多核細胞內的異常訊號，證實為多核腫瘤性漿細胞而非蝕骨細胞。
features: Giant multinucleated cell with numerous round to oval nuclei clustered centrally and abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei show coarse, clock-face-like clumped chromatin typical of plasma cells rather than the fine chromatin and nucleoli of osteoclast nuclei
Cytoplasm lacks the pink granularity of osteoclasts; small vacuoles present
Additional binucleated and multinucleated atypical plasma cells with perinuclear hof in panels B-D
FISH (panel E): multinucleated cell with arrows marking nuclei carrying abnormal probe signals, confirming clonality
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a giant multinucleated cell with many clustered nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, mimicking an osteoclast. The nuclei, however, have coarsely clumped plasma cell-type chromatin and the cytoplasm lacks the eosinophilic granularity of osteoclasts; similar binucleated and multinucleated atypical plasma cells are present in adjacent fields. Interphase FISH performed on the multinucleated cell demonstrates abnormal signal patterns in its nuclei (arrows), indicating that it belongs to the neoplastic clone. Findings are consistent with plasma cell neoplasm with multinucleated (osteoclast-like) myeloma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have separated, uniform nuclei with fine chromatin and single nucleoli in abundant pink granular cytoplasm, and are CD138 negative/CD68 positive.
Megakaryocytes have one lobulated polyploid nucleus with granular pink-purple cytoplasm rather than multiple separate plasma cell-type nuclei.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma with tumor giant cells
ddx.vs: Carcinoma giant cells arise in cohesive keratin-positive clusters, not among CD138-positive, light-chain-restricted plasma cells.
Occasional binucleation occurs in reactive plasmacytosis, but giant multinucleated forms with abnormal FISH signals indicate a clonal neoplasm.
